description: Test fixtures for kmptoolkit-systembars. RecordingSystemBarsController is a faithful SystemBarsController double: overrides stack, the newest wins a shared axis, an override claims only the axes it names, and releasing one restores whatever is underneath it at that moment — so a test can assert what a screen claims and that it leaves no layer behind. RecordingScreenWakeLockController does the same for ScreenWakeLockController, recording every setKeepScreenOn call. Pick this module as a testImplementation dependency alongside kmptoolkit-systembars when you want those assertions without a real Activity, UIApplication or window.
